name: kmrg-monorepo
description: Monorepo KMRG: Backend (Node.js + PostgreSQL), Admin Web (React + Vite) y Mobile App (React Native + Expo)

scripts.build:apk: npm --prefix mobile-app exec -- eas build -p android --profile preview
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p backend && npx tsc --noEmit -p admin-web && npx tsc --noEmit -p mobile-app
